svg.title: How to restore PDF file associations when Windows changes the default app
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to restore PDF file associations when Windows
changes the default app
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-23
First, check which app handles PDFs
PDF problems are often caused not by a broken
app but by a change in which app is associated
with opening .pdf files.
Change the default app for .pdf files
in Settings
Microsoft Support instructs you to open Settings
and go to Apps > Default apps. (1) Open
Settings. (2) Select Apps > Default apps. (3)…
Verify the change with an actual file
The process is not finished just because the
value changed in Settings.
Checklist when the setting changes
back
Users in the Microsoft Q&A community have
reported that the default PDF app reverted to
Microsoft’s default after a reboot.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
